questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Orange construction signs warn drivers about construction zones. This sign tells you a flagger is ahead. You must follow the flagger's directions.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Cars in right lane must slow down.
Pass only in the right lane.

questions.explanation: This sign warns you that two lanes of traffic are coming together into one. Be prepared to merge safely.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs alert drivers to hazards ahead. This sign warns you that cattle may cross the road.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This regulation sign tells drivers when they can turn left. Wait for the left turn signal to show it is safe to turn.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You must come to a complete stop.
Drive with caution and be ready to stop.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must come to a complete stop.
questions.explanation: An eight-sided sign always means stop. You must come to a complete stop and wait for vehicles and pedestrians to clear before proceeding.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This regulation sign limits how long you can park. You can park for a maximum of two hours during the posted times.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Should maintain your vehicle’s speed until you enter the reduced speed zone.
Should begin to reduce your vehicle’s speed.
Should not slow down because traffic will start to back up.
May reduce your speed, if you choose to do so.

questions.correctAnswerText: Should begin to reduce your vehicle’s speed.
questions.explanation: This sign tells you to start slowing down. A new, lower speed limit sign will appear ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This regulation sign designates reserved parking spaces. These spaces are for vehicles with a handicap sticker, tag, or license plate.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a divided highway is ahead. The road splits into two separate one-way roads. Stay to the right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you of a pedestrian crossing ahead. Watch for people crossing the road. Slow down and be ready to stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: You cannot make a U-turn where this sign is posted.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead curves left, then right.
The road ahead curves right, then left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead curves right, then left.
questions.explanation: The road ahead will curve right and then left. Slow down to safely navigate these curves.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Deer cross the road in this area. Slow down, stay alert, and be ready to stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Traffic flows only in the direction of the arrow.

questions.correctAnswerText: Traffic flows only in the direction of the arrow.
questions.explanation: Traffic can only move in the direction the arrow points.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Watch for traffic on your right.
Don’t park on the right side of the street.

questions.explanation: A red circle with a slash through a symbol means that action is not allowed. In this case, right turns are prohibited.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road to the right is for one-way traffic only.
That due to upcoming roadwork, there is a detour to the right.
Slow down because the road ahead changes direction at an extreme angle.
There is a crossroad to your right.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down because the road ahead changes direction at an extreme angle.
questions.explanation: The road ahead makes a sharp turn. Slow down as much as you would at an intersection.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Five-sided signs warn of schools nearby. Watch for children and pedestrians. Obey any crossing guard instructions.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells drivers that parking is not allowed in this area.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This warning sign alerts you to a winding road ahead. Adjust your speed accordingly.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Do not drive below the minimum speed shown on this sign.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The traffic signal ahead is displaying a red light.
The traffic signal ahead is broken.
The traffic signal ahead is displaying a green light.
There is a traffic signal ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: There is a traffic signal ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a traffic signal is coming at the next intersection.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Stop completely and check for pedestrians and cross traffic.
Slow down without coming to a complete stop.
Stop completely and wait for a green light.
Slow down and check for traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop completely and check for pedestrians and cross traffic.
questions.explanation: An eight-sided sign is always a stop sign. You must come to a complete stop and look for pedestrians and other vehicles. Do not proceed until the intersection is clear.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Stop only if other cars are approaching.

questions.explanation: This sign shows where bicycles regularly cross or ride in the area. Drive carefully and watch for cyclists.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A three-sided sign tells you to slow down and be ready to stop at the intersection. Let other drivers and pedestrians go first. You may continue when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign is posted on one-way streets to warn you not to enter from the wrong direction. Stop and turn around if you see this sign.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs with black markings alert you to upcoming hazards. This sign tells you a traffic signal is ahead. Be ready to stop for a red light or yellow light and watch for cross traffic.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells drivers in the left lane that they must turn left at the intersection.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a steep hill is coming.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Circular signs warn of railroad crossings ahead. Watch for trains and be ready to stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means the road ahead splits into separated lanes. Stay to the right of the divider.
